mutants.label: non-insertion ledger changes are silently ignored instead of refusing
the per-entry base assertion is gone: origin-side entry edits merge silently
the per-section base assertion is gone: origin-side section edits are overwritten
conflicts outside the allowlist no longer refuse up front
mutants.find:
outside = sorted(path for path in conflicts if not is_allowlisted(path))
    if outside:
        report.outside_allowlist = outside
        raise RefusalError("conflicting files outside the allowlist: " + ", ".join(outside))

mutants.label: the newest-first date re-sort is dropped after insertion
a failing vault-health run no longer blocks the replay
mutants.find:
if proc.returncode != 0:
        report.health = "failed"
        tail = (proc.stderr.strip() or proc.stdout.strip()).splitlines()[-3:]
        raise RefusalError(
            "vault health failed on the replayed tree; nothing was pushed"
            + (f" ({' | '.join(tail)})" if tail else "")
        )
    report.health = "passed"

mutants.label: an unreachable origin fails open as 'not diverged' instead of refusing
mutants.replace:
fetch = _run_git("fetch", "--quiet", "--", remote, target)
    if fetch.returncode != 0:
        report.action = "none"
        report.reason = "origin unreachable; treating as not diverged"
        return

mutants.label: a missing anchor on origin is guessed (first heading) instead of refused
mutants.replace:
if not candidates:
            candidates = [idx for idx, _lvl, _raw in origin_headings]

mutants.label: a mid-replay failure no longer restores the original branch and tree
byte-identical entries origin already holds are inserted again (duplicates)
touched handoff sections are never re-applied: origin wins everything
mutants.find: touched = [name for name, _raw, body in b_secs if t_map[name] != body]

mutants.label: the replay fetches the local branch's namesake instead of the sync target
the replay moves the target branch (local main) instead of the session's own branch
[control] reorder the new_head and action writes on the success report
mutants.why: Two writes to distinct attributes of the same in-memory dataclass with no read of either field between them; _replay is single-threaded and the Report is only observed after it returns, so the order is inert on every path the suite can reach.
